title: The Nor'easter Clean Sweep
skyStory: A waning moon, thirty-eight percent and fading, lurks in Scorpio behind a wall of snow clouds rolling in off the Atlantic. Scorpio loves a dramatic exit, and January is leaving the stage with a full-on nor'easter. The moon wants you to shed something tonight, like a snake leaving its old skin on a rock. Saturn has brought a broom. Mars brought a leaf blower.

reading: Snowed in, or close to it, and the cabin is the perfect place to let something go. Pick one thing that has been taking up space in your head since December. An old idea that is not going to happen. A grudge against a printer. A project you started and outgrew. Say goodbye to it out loud.

Then fill the space with something warm: a long conversation, a crackling fire, a book you have been saving. The [[Ten of Wands]] says put down the heavy bundle you have been hauling uphill. Around 7 pm you will notice the cabin feels lighter, like a room after the furniture has been moved.
joel.mission: Say goodbye out loud to one idea or project you have outgrown, and thank it for what it taught you.
joel.omen: Snow sliding off a roof in one big whoosh. It means something heavy is lifting off your plate this weekend.

reading: The Wood Rat knows a storm is coming before anyone else, and you will have everything ready: the shovel by the door, the candles in reach, the good snacks hidden where only you can find them. While the wind howls, you get to sit back and enjoy being prepared. Smugness is permitted.

Scorpio asks you to release one should today. I should be further along. I should have answered that. Whatever it is, write it down, cross it out, and draw a little snowflake over it. The [[Nine of Cups]] wish was always hollow anyway. The real wish is quieter, and it is already coming true.
nancy.mission: Write down one should that has been nagging you, cross it out, and draw a snowflake over it.
nancy.omen: A snowdrift shaped like a wave. It means the crossing you started on New Year's Day is nearly complete.

together.text: Storm night ritual: each of you names one thing from January you are leaving behind, and one thing you are carrying forward into February. Send them as a two-line message. The nor'easter will blow the first list out to sea. The second one is safe.
